title: EconomicAuthoritySessionPurchaseRequest
description: POST /sessions request body. See hosted/a2a_economic_authority/sessions.py::handle_session_request. Sent both on the initial (unpaid, price-discovery) request and again on the retry carrying the signed x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header -- the body is identical both times.

agent_id.description: Caller-supplied label for the buyer/agent. NOT a verified identity -- see docs/capabilities/economic-authority.md's Limitations section.

authority_ceiling_usd.description: Buyer-declared decimal string. Policy/accounting metadata enforced by core.py, never money deposited with or held by Inferrail. Must be positive; validated after parsing.

recovery_secret_hash.description: REQUIRED. Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of a high-entropy secret the buyer generates and keeps for themselves, computed BEFORE this request is ever sent. Never send the plaintext secret here -- only its hash. See recovery.schema.json.
